# AOTC, LLC (Ads of the Century)

> AOTC, LLC (Ads of the Century) is a mobile digital billboard company: LED billboard trucks, planned and run across the United States from its home base in Chicago. It specializes in rotational campaigns (10-second rotations shared by up to six brands, never two competitors in the same rotation; exclusive single-brand bookings quoted separately), routes planned by daypart around the audience, creative designed in-house, GPS-tracked routes, and photos of the ad on the street after every run.

Also known as: AOTC, AOTC LLC, Ads of the Century, Advertisements of the Century, AOTC Media, adsofthecentury.net

- Phone: (773) 708-1400 (call or text, 24/7)
- Email: info@adsofthecentury.net
- Home base: Chicago, Illinois. Campaigns nationwide.
- Get a route plan and quote: the Book Now button on any page of https://adsofthecentury.net/, usually answered the same day

## Key facts
- Screens: full-size LED screens on both sides and the rear carry the full ad: sides 11.76 x 6.30 ft (1920 x 1029 px), rear 6.71 x 6.30 ft (1080 x 1014 px). AOTC's own truck adds a front screen, 6.71 x 3.36 ft (1280 x 641 px). Files: JPG, PNG or MP4.
- Standard bookings are rotational: 10-second rotations shared by up to six brands, with no competing brand in the same rotation; share of voice runs from about 15% to 100%. Exclusive bookings put one brand alone on the truck and are quoted separately.
- Delivery record: GPS-tracked routes and photos of the ad on the street after every run. Response is measured with QR codes, promo codes, vanity URLs or call tracking.
- Free tool: the Display Studio (https://adsofthecentury.net/display.html) previews your design on the real truck before you book.
- Clients see their truck live in the Golden Ticket route room.
- Cities where AOTC, LLC has run its own campaigns: Chicago (the Loop, Wrigleyville, River North, Chinatown, Fulton Market, Grant Park), Bedford Park, IL; Hammond, Whiting and East Chicago, IN; the I-94 corridor in Northwest Indiana; Michigan City, IN; and New Buffalo, MI.
- As seen on: WGN-TV, NBC 5 Chicago, ABC7 Chicago, FOX 32 Chicago, Telemundo Chicago, The Times of Northwest Indiana (nwi.com).

## Services
- [Grand opening and launch mobile billboards](https://adsofthecentury.net/grand-opening-mobile-billboards.html): Countdown routes, opening-day saturation and same-day multi-city rollouts. Wendy's, Uncle Sam's Fireworks.
- [Game-day and stadium mobile billboards](https://adsofthecentury.net/game-day-mobile-billboards.html): Arrivals, the neighborhood and the exodus around ballparks, stadiums and parades. American Precision Services, Hammond Hermits.
- [Downtown mobile billboards](https://adsofthecentury.net/downtown-mobile-billboards.html): Business, shopping and nightlife districts by daypart. Realty of America, HCDS.
- [Event and festival mobile billboards](https://adsofthecentury.net/event-festival-mobile-billboards.html): Festival gates, perimeters and neighborhood events. Belmont Cragin, FAB 94.5, DJ GloBoy, Makako's, Lakefront.
- [Trade show and convention mobile billboards](https://adsofthecentury.net/trade-show-mobile-billboards.html): Convention-center loops, hotel corridors and show-week timing, from McCormick Place to the Las Vegas Convention Center.
- [Political, labor and advocacy mobile billboards](https://adsofthecentury.net/political-mobile-billboards.html): Campaigns, unions, causes and public affairs, ward by ward. USW Local 7-1.
- [Mobile billboard tours and multi-city campaigns](https://adsofthecentury.net/mobile-billboard-tours.html): Roadshows, same-day multi-market launches and event circuits, one plan and one point of contact.
- [LED screen truck rental for events](https://adsofthecentury.net/led-screen-truck-rental.html): Four HD screens on site for activations, watch parties and movie nights. Elevated Exotics.

## Campaigns
- Wendy's (Quick service · Grand opening, Bedford Park, IL): A full-motion route through the corridors that feed the store, timed to meal and commute windows, then the truck out front on opening day with the mascots, the opening message on every screen and a QR code for the offer. Opening week landed like an event, not a soft open. The trade area saw Wendy's on the days that mattered most. [https://adsofthecentury.net/grand-opening-mobile-billboards.html#wendys]
- American Precision Services (Industrial B2B · Cubs Opening Day, Chicago, IL): Eight-hour routes for seven consecutive days across the Loop, Wrigleyville, Chinatown and Fulton Market, with Cubs Opening Day at Wrigley Field as the marquee window. A company most people never see became the brand in front of the season's first crowd, and in front of the city all week. [https://adsofthecentury.net/game-day-mobile-billboards.html#american-precision-services]
- USW Local 7-1 (Labor · Public awareness, Indiana to downtown Chicago): Four activations: a community parade in Hammond, two hours circling the BP facility, a solidarity march from East Chicago through Hammond and Whiting to BP's downtown Chicago offices, and Festival of the Lakes. One message carried through four public moments, four cities and two states, and onto the local news. [https://adsofthecentury.net/political-mobile-billboards.html#usw-local-7-1]
- Uncle Sam's Fireworks (Retail · Seasonal peak, I-94 Exit 68B, Indiana): A placement beside the traffic stream with Exit 68B in the same view, so the offer and the turn arrived together. When a storm closure sent traffic toward that exit, the truck was already there. The only fireworks message drivers met before the exit. Fixed billboards couldn't follow the detour. The truck didn't have to. [https://adsofthecentury.net/grand-opening-mobile-billboards.html#uncle-sams-fireworks]
- Elevated Exotics (Exotic car rentals · On-site event, New Buffalo, MI): All four screens on site as an entertainment layer, with movies and video games running live. Then a two-day, three-state run: New Buffalo, Michigan City Premium Outlets and Grant Park during Sueños. Elevated Exotics came back for a second, bigger campaign: from a 24-hour turnaround to a three-state route in front of a 100,000-plus festival audience. [https://adsofthecentury.net/led-screen-truck-rental.html#elevated-exotics]
- Realty of America · April Starr (Real estate · St. Patrick's weekend, Downtown Chicago): Three days built around the weekend's attention: river-dyeing crowds, parade traffic, bar crawls and nightlife. April's portrait, phone number and "Buy, Sell, Invest, Lease" on every screen. She didn't share the screen. She owned it, from the daytime crowds to the Loop after dark. [https://adsofthecentury.net/downtown-mobile-billboards.html#realty-of-america]
- HCDS Mental Health (Nonprofit mental health · Sueños weekend, Downtown Chicago): Three consecutive days of downtown routes with bright orange creative: the services, insurance accepted, and a phone number plus a QR code for a direct next step. The message stayed legible against the downtown architecture, from sidewalk and roadway, with two easy ways to reach them. [https://adsofthecentury.net/downtown-mobile-billboards.html#hcds]
- Hammond Hermits (Youth baseball & softball · Opening Day, Hammond, IN): League identity, every team's logo and opening-day messaging on all four screens. AOTC led the parade through Hammond, then was given a place near the outfield for the opening ceremony. The role grew in real time, from parade participant to parade leader to part of the ceremony. [https://adsofthecentury.net/game-day-mobile-billboards.html#hammond-hermits]
- Belmont Cragin Vintage Fest (Community event · Neighborhood, Chicago, IL): Two modes in one day: routes through the busy streets around Belmont Cragin with the date, hours and address, then the truck at the entrance as the arrival marker. The fest felt active before guests stepped inside. The truck went from advertising the event to being part of it. [https://adsofthecentury.net/event-festival-mobile-billboards.html#belmont-cragin]
- FAB 94.5 The Hitz (Radio · Festival route, Hammond, IN): A six-hour Hammond route during Festival of the Lakes: oversized station identity, "Chicago's #1 Hitz Station" and clear ways to listen live and follow. A moving station billboard in front of a crowd of more than 40,000. [https://adsofthecentury.net/event-festival-mobile-billboards.html#fab-94-5]
- DJ GloBoy (Entertainment · Festival route, Hammond, IN): A booking card on a six-hour Hammond route during Festival of the Lakes, in front of a crowd that matched his sound. His name and booking line in front of the festival crowd, on its own screen time. [https://adsofthecentury.net/event-festival-mobile-billboards.html#dj-globoy]
- Makako's Auto Repair (Auto repair · Festival route, Hammond, IN): "We Diagnose. Call Now. Get Answers." on a six-hour Hammond route during Festival of the Lakes. A local service brand in front of more than 40,000 festival-goers, with one clear call to action. [https://adsofthecentury.net/event-festival-mobile-billboards.html#makakos]
- Lakefront Nutrition & Fitness (Health & fitness · Festival route, Hammond & Whiting, IN): Its summer IV special on a six-hour Hammond route during Festival of the Lakes. The offer reached the festival crowd, and people stopped to photograph the truck. [https://adsofthecentury.net/event-festival-mobile-billboards.html#lakefront]
- Also on the truck: Summer's End Smokeout, Agudath Israel of Illinois, VS Mobile Arcade
